name: VT Industrial Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: VT Industrial Technology Co.,Ltd, founded in Wuxi, China, in 2008, is an enterprise dedicated to the comprehensive development, production, and distribution of automotive-related products. The company's core operations span the research, design, manufacturing, and sale of automotive stamping dies, specialized inspection tools, vehicle stampings, and welded parts. Its diverse offerings include critical automotive systems like body-in-white structures, exhaust systems, instrument panels, door and seating assemblies, chassis systems, and fuel tanks, in addition to truck clutches, battery cases, powerpack systems, and press automation solutions.
